instruction.text: Select the image of the ocean.

feedback.finish: The ocean is a continuous body of salt water that covers a large portion of our planet.

instruction.text: What percentage of the Earth does the ocean cover?
This large body of water has been split into five different oceans. Drag the names of the oceans to the correct colours.

atoms.b: The Pacific Ocean spreads across both sides of the map and is the largest of the ((rivers ++oceans)). The Arctic Ocean is the smallest and shallowest.
The closest ocean to the UK is the ((Southern ++Atlantic)).

instruction.text: The ocean has three zones. Select each zone to find out more.

feedback.end: This zone gets lots of sunlight and contains the majority of the ocean’s life. It is home to fish, sharks, seaweed and many more animals and plants.
This zone receives a little sunlight, but plants cannot survive here. The animals in this zone either eat plant matter that has fallen down from the sunlight zone or other animals.

It is very dark and cold in this zone because there is no sunlight. Plants are also unable to survive here, but there are some animals that have specially adapted to survive in this zone, such as giant squid.

instruction.text: The animals and plants in the ocean have adapted to their habitat. Select the two adaptations of jellyfish.

hint.text: If something is translucent, it allows some light to pass through it.
hint.label: Translucent

b: fifty eyes to help them see prey
